entities.summary: Alexandra Louise Mayer is a British Labour Party politician who has served as the Member of Parliament (MP) for Dunstable and Leighton Buzzard since 2024. She was previously a Member of the European Parliament (MEP) for the East of England region from 2016 to 2019.
